items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Zoo was one trombone player, and Eddie Atkins was the other, too. ... And they put me in the band. So that made me the third trombone player, third trumpet player in the band

ctx.x: I thought you were in Clarence Jones.
One time Clarence Williams did have a publishing house here at your music store.
